claims.claim_text: Exact private-identifier and name agreement confirms the indexed Vernon A. Bush identity in the official Army merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The OSS index and Army entry record share the exact private identifier and full indexed name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through exact private-identifier, first name, middle initial, and surname agreement across official records.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record dates entry as a private to June 12, 1942; it does not establish the later Army-to-OSS assignment date.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier remains masked publicly. Same-name web and cemetery candidates lacking the private identifier were not used.

claims.temporal_assessment: Accessible biographies document age-compatible identities and careers, but neither directly links a namesake to Box 97 or establishes a pre-OSS chronology for the indexed person.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index establishes Billie V. Bush as a lieutenant in Box 96 but supplies no branch, private identifier, or distinguishing note. Official-context, CIA Reading Room, current Library of Congress API, exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, military, newspaper, obituary, directory, and institutional searches did not produce two corroborating identifiers.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 96 for full legal name, branch, identifiers, personnel status, employer, and pre-OSS chronology before assigning any Billie or Billy V. Bush candidate.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index establishes only the initials F. E. Bush in Box 96 and supplies no rank, private identifier, or distinguishing note. Official-context, CIA Reading Room, current Library of Congress API, OSS, employer, occupation, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches were too broad to resolve the incomplete name.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 96 for the full given names, identifiers, personnel status, employer, and pre-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index prints George S. Bush, Pvt, and a private identifier in Box 96. That identifier has no exact match in the official processed Army file. Three different exact-name private entrants appear under other identifiers, so none is assigned; documented omissions and conversion errors mean the printed identifier's absence is not disproof.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 96 and the original service record to verify the printed identifier and distinguish the indexed private from multiple exact-name Army candidates before assigning occupation or employer.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 97 and original military records to verify the printed identifier, rank, assignment, occupation, employer, and chronology before selecting any Gordon W. Bush candidate.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 97 for a named bakery employer, precise baking role, Army-to-OSS assignment date, and OSS duties.
